items.title: Return completed damage questionnaire and game-damage certificate
items.quote: Senden Sie uns das ausgefüllte Formular bitte binnen 13 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens zurück (Werktage: Montag bis Samstag ohne gesetzliche Feiertage).
items.computation: The letter is dated Sat 21.11.2026. The period runs 'nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens' (after the date of this letter), so per §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the letter itself (21.11.) is excluded and counting starts on 22.11.2026. The letter itself defines 'Werktage' as Monday-Saturday excluding statutory public holidays (so Sundays are skipped, not counted). Counting forward from 22.11.2026: 22.11 Sun (skip), 23.11 Mon=1, 24.11 Tue=2, 25.11 Wed=3, 26.11 Thu=4, 27.11 Fri=5, 28.11 Sat=6, 29.11 Sun (skip), 30.11 Mon=7, 01.12 Tue=8, 02.12 Wed=9, 03.12 Thu=10, 04.12 Fri=11, 05.12 Sat=12, 06.12 Sun (skip), 07.12 Mon=13. No NRW public holidays fall in this interval (Nov 22-Dec 7, 2026). So the 13th Werktag, and the deadline, is Monday 07.12.2026.
